summary.name: Watercolor (supplemental design reference; category Drawing and Illustration; not a directly named style in the source collection)
summary.visualIdentity: Translucent pigment washes with visible paper grain, soft bleeding edges, and selective dry-brush detail. Lighter paper areas stay preserved, and pigment overlaps look believable. Uniform blur and repeatedly changing random stains are excluded.
summary.suitableUses: Explicitly suited to gentle narrative or mood work, product and editorial introductions, and illustrated or abstract sequences with meaningful chapters. Inferred fit: reflective or journal-like topics. Data stories and labeled explainers need a hybrid combination.
summary.limitations: Wash development must animate gently, never as uniform blur or changing random stains. Chapter transitions should be omitted when the topic is too short for chapters or when a transition obscures causality. The source calls Watercolor often best alone. Contrast checks cover only two-color pairs, not textured or video backgrounds.
summary.palette: Optional suggestions, used only when no task, brand, or approved palette is supplied: background #FBF6EB (dominant), foreground #3C4E58 (text and layout), accents #8EA8B6, #BF8E7A, and #9BAE8E (subordinate). Gradients are disabled. Foreground on background measures 8.042, passing 4.5. Accents fail for body text, so body text belongs on the background. Supplied exact colors override these, and composited frames must be rechecked.
summary.motionAndInteraction: Wash development and layered reveals animate gently, computed from composition time for video. Motion-012 (chapter handoff) and motion-015 (narrative steps) are optional and used only when the scene supports them; neither is required. Interactive output may bind scroll progress, with reduced-motion showing final washes. Video must not depend on live input. Easing is not mandatory; deliberate cuts and reading holds are kept.
summary.audio: The source specifies no audio requirement. Inferred suggestions: restrained ambience or music for gentle pacing, optional voiceover for explanation, sparse sound accents on reveals, and silence during reading holds. Sung vocals may compete with narration. No genre, tempo, or instrument is fixed. Speech must stay intelligible and unclipped.
summary.assetRequirements: Explicit requirements: precomputed pigment layers, paper textures, and reveal masks. Local fonts and assets must load before rendering. Randomness is seeded, and stateful simulations are cached. The source does not list supplied assets, so any missing assets are unspecified. Audio assets must be authorized or created separately.
summary.combinations: Watercolor is often best alone. Style-097 suits wash-filled data charts: encodings use only primary pale accents, labels use #3C4E58, and washes never blur value boundaries. Style-024 suits handwritten field-note labels in #3C4E58 on retained paper, using one annotation voice. Avoid random stains on data, notes over dark washes, and extra ink colors.
summary.productionApproach: HyperFrames is the default pipeline for composition and export, using data-composition-id, data-width and data-height, timed clip elements, and one paused GSAP timeline registered in window.__timelines. Validate with npx hyperframes check and render with npx hyperframes render. Remotion is a fallback only when HyperFrames is unavailable or a verified limit applies. Visuals come from Canvas 2D, with Python and Pillow for preprocessing. chroma-js is optional for color checks, and @remotion/noise is optional for grain.
